title: Otelde oda almak
situation: You arrive at a hotel late in the evening. You booked a room last week.
situationTr: Otele akşam geç saatte varıyorsun. Geçen hafta bir oda ayırtmıştın.
prompts: Give your name and say you have a booking.
Ask what time breakfast starts.
Ask if there is an elevator.
Say you would like a quiet room.
promptsTr: Adını söyle ve rezervasyonun olduğunu belirt.

usefulPhrases.en: I have a booking for two nights.
What time does breakfast start?
Is there an elevator to the third floor?
Could I have a quiet room, please?
usefulPhrases.tr: Sessiz bir oda alabilir miyim lütfen?

usefulPhrases.en: What time must I leave the room?

title: Geçen yaz tatili
situation: A friend asks about your holiday last summer. Talk about where you went and what you did.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın geçen yazki tatilini soruyor. Nereye gittiğini ve ne yaptığını anlat.
prompts: Where did you go and who with?
How did you travel?
What was the weather like?
What did you enjoy most?

usefulPhrases.en: We went to the coast for a week.
We traveled by train.
The weather was hot and sunny.
The best part was the food.
I would like to go again.

title: Kıyafet değiştirmek
situation: You bought a shirt yesterday but it is too small. Go back to the shop.
situationTr: Dün bir gömlek aldın ama çok küçük geldi. Dükkâna geri dön.
prompts: Explain the problem.
Ask for a bigger size.
Show that you have the receipt.
Ask about getting your money back.

usefulPhrases.en: I bought this yesterday but it is too small.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bunu dün aldım ama çok küçük geldi.

usefulPhrases.en: Do you have a bigger size?
Here is the receipt.
Can I have my money back?
Can I try it on?

title: Bir arkadaşı davet etmek
situation: You want to invite a friend to your birthday dinner on Saturday.
situationTr: Cumartesi günkü doğum günü yemeğine bir arkadaşını davet etmek istiyorsun.
prompts: Invite your friend and say when.
Say where it is.
Say who else is coming.
Answer if your friend cannot come.
promptsTr: Arkadaşını davet et ve zamanı söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Would you like to come to my birthday dinner?
usefulPhrases.tr: Doğum günü yemeğime gelmek ister misin?

usefulPhrases.en: It is at eight on Saturday.
It is at the restaurant near the station.
Do not worry, we can meet another time.
usefulPhrases.tr: Merak etme, başka bir zaman buluşuruz.

usefulPhrases.en: Let me know by Thursday.

title: Otobüste unutulan çanta
situation: You left your bag on the bus. Report it at the bus station office.
situationTr: Çantanı otobüste unuttun. Otogardaki ofiste bildir.
prompts: Say what happened and when.
Describe the bag.
Say what was inside.
Give your telephone number.
promptsTr: Ne olduğunu ve ne zaman olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I left my bag on the bus this morning.
It is black and quite small.
There were some books inside.
Could you call me if you find it?
My number is on this paper.

title: Doktordan randevu almak
situation: You telephone the health center to make an appointment for this week.
situationTr: Bu hafta için randevu almak üzere sağlık ocağını arıyorsun.
prompts: Say who you are and why you are calling.
Say which days you are free.
Ask how long the visit takes.
Ask what you should bring.
promptsTr: Kim olduğunu ve neden aradığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like to make an appointment.
I am free on Tuesday afternoon.
How long does it take?
Should I bring anything?
Could you say that again, please?

title: İki şehri karşılaştırmak
situation: You have lived in two cities. Compare them for a friend who wants to move.
situationTr: İki şehirde yaşadın. Taşınmak isteyen bir arkadaşın için ikisini karşılaştır.
prompts: Which city is bigger?
Which is cheaper to live in?
Which has better transport?
Which do you prefer and why?

usefulPhrases.en: The first city is much bigger.
Life is cheaper in the second one.
The buses are better there.
I prefer the smaller city.
It is quieter and I have more friends there.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha sakin ve orada daha çok arkadaşım var.

title: Soğuk gelen yemek
situation: You are in a restaurant. Your food is cold and you waited a long time.
situationTr: Bir restorandasın. Yemeğin soğuk ve uzun süre bekledin.
prompts: Call the waiter politely.
Explain the problem.
Say what you would like them to do.
Ask about the bill.

usefulPhrases.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
I am afraid this food is cold.
We waited for forty minutes.
Could you bring a hot one, please?
Could we have the bill, please?

title: Yeni bir iş
situation: You started a new job last month. A friend asks how it is going.
situationTr: Geçen ay yeni bir işe başladın. Bir arkadaşın nasıl gittiğini soruyor.
prompts: Say what you do there.
Say what the hours are.
Say what you like about it.
Say what is difficult.

usefulPhrases.en: I work in an office near the park.
I start at nine and finish at six.
The people there are very friendly.
The hardest thing is the early mornings.
I think I will stay.

title: Gelecek yıl planların
situation: Your teacher asks about your plans for next year. Talk about what you want to do.
situationTr: Öğretmenin gelecek yılki planlarını soruyor. Ne yapmak istediğini anlat.
prompts: Say what you are going to study or do.
Say where you want to live.
Say what you want to learn.
Say what might change your plan.
promptsTr: Ne okuyacağını ya da yapacağını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I am going to study computers.
I hope to live in a bigger city.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha büyük bir şehirde yaşamayı umuyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to learn to drive.
If I do not pass the exam, I will wait a year.
I am not sure yet.

title: Kargoyu sormak
situation: You ordered a pair of shoes ten days ago and they have not arrived. You call the shop.
situationTr: On gün önce bir çift ayakkabı sipariş ettin ve gelmedi. Mağazayı arıyorsun.
prompts: Say what you ordered and when.
Explain that it has not arrived.
Give your order number.
Ask what they can do.
promptsTr: Ne sipariş ettiğini ve ne zaman ettiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I ordered a pair of shoes on the fifth of March.
usefulPhrases.tr: Beş Mart'ta bir çift ayakkabı sipariş ettim.

usefulPhrases.en: They still have not arrived.
My order number is four seven two one.
usefulPhrases.tr: Sipariş numaram dört yedi iki bir.

usefulPhrases.en: Could you check where the package is?
If it is lost, I would like my money back.

title: Bir daireye bakmak
situation: You are visiting an apartment you may rent. Ask the owner your questions.
situationTr: Kiralayabileceğin bir daireyi geziyorsun. Ev sahibine sorularını sor.
prompts: Ask about the rent and the bills.
Ask how many rooms there are.
Ask about buses and shops nearby.
Say what you think of the apartment.

usefulPhrases.en: How much is the rent each month?
Are the bills included?
How far is the bus stop?
The kitchen is smaller than I expected.
I like it, but I need to think about it.

title: Spor salonuna yazılmak
situation: You want to join a gym near your home. Talk to the person at the desk.
situationTr: Evine yakın bir spor salonuna yazılmak istiyorsun. Danışmadaki kişiyle konuş.
prompts: Say why you want to join.
Ask about the prices.
Ask when the gym is open.
Ask if you can try it first.
promptsTr: Salonun ne zaman açık olduğunu sor.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to get fit before the summer.
How much is it for three months?
What time do you open at the weekend?
Can I try it for one day first?
Do I need to bring my own towel?

title: Buluşmayı başka güne almak
situation: You cannot meet your friend on Saturday any more. Call her and change the day.
situationTr: Cumartesi arkadaşınla buluşamayacaksın. Onu ara ve günü değiştir.
prompts: Say that you cannot come on Saturday.
Explain why.
Suggest another day.
Say you are sorry.

usefulPhrases.en: I am afraid I cannot come on Saturday.
My brother is arriving that morning.
Could we meet on Sunday instead?
I am really sorry about this.
Any time after two is fine for me.
usefulPhrases.tr: İkiden sonra her saat benim için uygun.

title: Kuaförde
situation: You are at the hairdresser. Explain what you want and answer her questions.
situationTr: Kuafördesin. Ne istediğini anlat ve sorularını yanıtla.
prompts: Say what you would like.
Say how short you want it.
Say when you were here last.
Ask how much it will cost.
promptsTr: En son ne zaman geldiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like a haircut, please.
Not too short at the back.
I was here about two months ago.
How much will that be?
That is fine, thank you.

title: Bir kurstan bahsetmek
situation: A friend is thinking about the English course you are taking. Tell her about it.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın gittiğin İngilizce kursunu düşünüyor. Ona kurstan bahset.
prompts: Say when and where the course is.
Say what you do in the lessons.
Say what you like about it.
Say one thing that is difficult.
promptsTr: Kursun ne zaman ve nerede olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: It is twice a week, on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
usefulPhrases.tr: Haftada iki kez, salı ve perşembe akşamları.

usefulPhrases.en: We speak a lot and we do very little grammar.
usefulPhrases.tr: Çok konuşuyoruz ve çok az dilbilgisi yapıyoruz.

usefulPhrases.en: The teacher is patient and she explains well.
The hardest part for me is listening.
usefulPhrases.tr: Benim için en zor kısım dinleme.

usefulPhrases.en: You should come and try one lesson.

title: Yol tarifi vermek
situation: A visitor stops you in the street. He is looking for the train station. Help him.
situationTr: Sokakta bir ziyaretçi seni durduruyor. Tren istasyonunu arıyor. Ona yardım et.
prompts: Tell him the way from here.
Say how long it takes on foot.
Mention something he will see on the way.
Tell him what to do if he gets lost.

usefulPhrases.en: Go straight on and take the second street on the left.
usefulPhrases.tr: Düz git ve soldaki ikinci sokağa sap.

usefulPhrases.en: It takes about ten minutes on foot.
You will pass a big hospital on your right.
usefulPhrases.tr: Sağında büyük bir hastanenin önünden geçeceksin.

usefulPhrases.en: If you get lost, ask again near the bridge.
You cannot miss it.

title: İşe hasta olduğunu bildirmek
situation: You woke up ill this morning. Call your manager and tell her.
situationTr: Bu sabah hasta uyandın. Müdürünü ara ve durumu bildir.
prompts: Say what is wrong.
Say that you cannot come in today.
Say what you will do about your work.
Say when you think you will be back.

usefulPhrases.en: I woke up with a high temperature.
I am afraid I cannot come in today.
I have sent the report to Ayla already.
I am going to the doctor this afternoon.
I hope to be back on Wednesday.

title: Bir şey ödünç istemek
situation: You need a suitcase for a short trip. Ask your neighbor if you can borrow hers.
situationTr: Kısa bir gezi için bavula ihtiyacın var. Komşuna onunkini ödünç alıp alamayacağını sor.
prompts: Ask for the suitcase politely.
Say why you need it.
Say when you will bring it back.
Thank her and offer something in return.
promptsTr: Teşekkür et ve karşılığında bir şey öner.

usefulPhrases.en: Could I borrow your suitcase for a few days?
usefulPhrases.tr: Birkaç günlüğüne bavulunu ödünç alabilir miyim?

usefulPhrases.en: I am going to Ankara on Friday.
I will bring it back on Monday evening.
Thank you, that is very kind of you.
Let me know if you need anything from there.

title: Yeni bir şehre taşınmak
situation: You moved to a new city three months ago. A friend asks how it is going.
situationTr: Üç ay önce yeni bir şehre taşındın. Bir arkadaşın nasıl gittiğini soruyor.
prompts: Say why you moved.
Say what is better than before.
Say what you miss.
Say how you are meeting people.
promptsTr: Öncekinden daha iyi olan şeyi söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I moved here because of my job.
The buses are much better here.
I miss my family and my old neighbors.
I have met a few people at the gym.
It was hard at first, but it is better now.
usefulPhrases.tr: Başta zordu ama şimdi daha iyi.

title: Faturadaki hata
situation: Your phone bill this month is much higher than usual. Call the company.
situationTr: Bu ayki telefon faturan her zamankinden çok yüksek. Şirketi ara.
prompts: Say what the problem is.
Say how much you usually pay.
Ask them to check the bill.
Ask what happens next.

usefulPhrases.en: There seems to be a mistake on my bill.
usefulPhrases.tr: Faturamda bir hata var gibi görünüyor.

usefulPhrases.en: I usually pay about two hundred lira a month.
usefulPhrases.tr: Normalde ayda yaklaşık iki yüz lira ödüyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: This month it is nearly double that.
Could you check it for me, please?
usefulPhrases.tr: Benim için kontrol edebilir misiniz, lütfen?

usefulPhrases.en: How long will it take to sort out?

title: Fotoğraf çekmesini istemek
titleEn: Asking Someone to Take a Photo
situation: You are on holiday with a friend. You want a photo of the two of you. Ask a stranger.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşınla tatildesin. İkinizin bir fotoğrafını istiyorsun. Bir yabancıdan rica et.
prompts: Ask politely for help.
Explain what you want in the photo.
Say which button to press.
Thank her and offer to do the same.
promptsTr: Teşekkür et ve aynısını yapmayı teklif et.

usefulPhrases.en: Excuse me, could you take a photo of us?
Could you get the bridge in the picture too?
Just press this round button.
Would you like me to take one of you?
usefulPhrases.tr: Sizin de bir fotoğrafınızı çekmemi ister misiniz?

usefulPhrases.en: That is lovely, thank you.

title: Bir arkadaşa teşekkür etmek
situation: A friend looked after your cat while you were away. Thank her properly.
situationTr: Sen yokken bir arkadaşın kedine baktı. Ona gerektiği gibi teşekkür et.
prompts: Thank her for what she did.
Say why it helped you.
Ask how the week went.
Offer to do something for her.
promptsTr: Onun için bir şey yapmayı teklif et.

usefulPhrases.en: Thank you so much for looking after Mia.
usefulPhrases.tr: Mia'ya baktığın için çok teşekkür ederim.

usefulPhrases.en: I could relax because I knew she was fine.
usefulPhrases.tr: İyi olduğunu bildiğim için rahat edebildim.

usefulPhrases.en: Was she any trouble?
Let me cook for you on Saturday.
I owe you one.

title: Hafta sonu gezisi
situation: You and a friend want to go somewhere for the weekend. Plan the trip together.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşınla hafta sonu bir yere gitmek istiyorsunuz. Geziyi birlikte planlayın.
prompts: Suggest a place and say why.
Say how you will travel.
Say where you can stay.
Say how much it will cost.
promptsTr: Bir yer öner ve nedenini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Why do we not go to Eskisehir? It is quiet and cheap.
usefulPhrases.tr: Eskişehir'e gitsek mi? Sakin ve ucuz.

usefulPhrases.en: The train leaves early on Saturday morning.
My cousin says there is a small hotel near the river.
usefulPhrases.tr: Kuzenim nehrin yanında küçük bir otel olduğunu söylüyor.

usefulPhrases.en: It should cost about a thousand lira each.
usefulPhrases.tr: Kişi başı yaklaşık bin lira tutmalı.

usefulPhrases.en: Shall we book the tickets tonight?

title: Bir ürünü iade etmek
situation: You bought a jacket last week and it is too small. Take it back to the shop.
situationTr: Geçen hafta bir ceket aldın ve küçük geldi. Onu mağazaya geri götür.
prompts: Say what you bought and when.
Explain the problem.
Say what you would like instead.
Answer if they ask for the receipt.
promptsTr: Ne aldığını ve ne zaman aldığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I bought this jacket here last Tuesday.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bu ceketi geçen salı buradan aldım.

usefulPhrases.en: It is too small for me.
Could I change it for a larger size?
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha büyük bir bedenle değiştirebilir miyim?

usefulPhrases.en: Here is the receipt.
If you do not have my size, I would like my money back.
